name: CashOfficeReconciliation
tagline: Blind till counts, over/short, safe counts and bank deposits – the whole store cash office in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete retail cash office: open till sessions with float and POS cash, count tills and safes by denomination with blind counting, see over/short against the tolerance and the investigation threshold, verify with the two-person rule, run investigations to an outcome, seal deposit bags from the verified takings, hand them to the courier and confirm the bank credit – with a day-by-till ledger, cashier variance and safe-limit alerts. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Blind count by denomination (configurable notes and coins) or total only
Expected cash = float + POS cash; over/short with tolerance and investigate thresholds
Investigations with reasons and a Store manager outcome
Recount, reopen, void and restore with an audit history
Deposit bags from verified tills with bag-amount check and unique seal numbers
Hand-over, banking deadline and bank-credit confirmation with bank variance
Safe counts against the insurance limit
Day-by-till over/short ledger and cashier variance
Undo, CSV export and printable count sheet
Power Fx outputs and events (CountSheetText, SummaryJson)
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
